### **Dec 11 · RIDESHARE-01 · I was in the back of a rideshare**

You were in the back seat of a rideshare when it got hit.  
Not your car. Not your insurance. Not your fault.  
So you figured it was not your problem either, and you went home.  
It is still your neck. The record of what happened to it starts with an examination, and nobody else is going to schedule that for you.  
Get checked here first. nowhiplash.com.

---
**Dec 12 · MORNING-01 · Worse in the morning**

Since the crash your neck is worst first thing in the morning, then it loosens up by lunch.  
That pattern is not random. It tells us something about what got injured.  
Pain that wakes you up at night tells us something different.  
Neither one is "just stiffness." Both belong in your record, with the time of day written next to them.  
nowhiplash.com.

---
**Dec 13 · HOMECARE-01 · The other 165 hours (bold)**

Three appointments a week is about three hours of care.  
There are 168 hours in a week. That leaves 165 where nobody is watching your neck.  
If your plan never told you what to do in those hours, what to avoid, and how to sleep, it is only covering a sliver of your week.  
Ask for the at home part in writing.  
nowhiplash.com.

---
**Dec 14 · PLAINWORDS-01 · Say it in plain words**

Somebody told you your diagnosis, and you nodded like you understood it.  
Most people do. Nobody wants to look slow in front of the doctor.  
So ask for it again, in plain words. What got hurt, how bad, and what happens next.  
You cannot make good decisions about an injury you cannot explain to your own family.  
nowhiplash.com.

---
**Dec 15 · HOLIDAYTRIP-01 · Crashed on the way to see family**

You got hit on the way to see family. You did not want to ruin the trip, so you powered through it and drove home.  
That is a lot of hours in a car seat on a neck that just got whipped.  
The holidays are not a reason to skip an examination. They are a reason to get one before the long drive back.  
nowhiplash.com.

---
**Dec 16 · COVERAGEEND-01 · Care that ends when the coverage ends (bold)**

Here is a question worth asking. Did your care end because you got better, or because the coverage ran out?  
Those should not be the same day.  
A care plan should follow what the examination finds, not what the policy pays.  
If nobody re-examined you before you were released, you do not actually know where you ended up.  
nowhiplash.com.

---
**Dec 17 · RECORDS-01 · How fast do your records move?**

If you have an attorney, they will ask your office for records. Sometimes more than once.  
How long that takes matters. Slow records slow your whole case.  
So ask your office one simple question at the start. When my attorney requests my records, how long does it take?  
The answer tells you how organized they really are.  
nowhiplash.com.

---
**Dec 18 · LIEN-01 · Read what you sign on day one**

On your first day, an office may hand you a lien to sign. That is normal in crash care.  
What is not normal is signing it without anybody explaining it.  
A lien is a promise about how your bill gets paid. Ask what it covers, when it is due, and what happens if your case settles low.  
Read it. Then sign it.  
nowhiplash.com.

---
**Dec 19 · SAMEPLAN-01 · Everyone in the car got the same plan (bold)**

Two people in the same car. Same crash. Same office. Same exact plan, down to the appointment count.  
Think about that. One was driving, one was in the back. Different seats, different angles, different bodies.  
Same crash does not mean same injury.  
If two people got identical plans before anyone measured them, the plan came from a template.  
nowhiplash.com.

---
**Dec 20 · HEADACHE-01 · The headache at the base of your skull**

A headache that starts right here, at the base of your skull, a few days after a crash.  
People blame stress, screens, or bad sleep.  
The joints at the top of your neck refer pain up into the head. A crash loads exactly those joints.  
New headache after a collision is a finding. Do not file it under stress until somebody looks.  
nowhiplash.com.

---
**Dec 21 · BACKSEAT-01 · The kids said they were fine**

The kids were in the back seat. You asked if they were okay and they said yes.  
Kids say yes. They want the scary part to be over.  
Watch them closely for the next few days. Rubbing their neck, headaches, trouble sleeping, not wanting to play.  
Small bodies take the same crash. Get them checked here too.  
nowhiplash.com.

---
**Dec 22 · FRONTDESK-01 · Who explained your plan? (bold)**

Who explained your care plan to you? The doctor who examined you, or somebody at the front desk with a price sheet?  
That matters more than people realize.  
Your plan should come from the person who put hands on you and read your images, and they should be able to explain every piece of it.  
If they cannot, ask why.  
nowhiplash.com.

---
**Dec 23 · SLEEP-01 · You have not slept right since the crash**

You have not slept right since the crash. Every position hurts, so you wake up three or four times a night.  
That is not a side note. Sleep is when injured tissue recovers, and you are not getting it.  
Tell us exactly how you are sleeping. It changes how we treat you and it belongs in your record.  
nowhiplash.com.

---
**Dec 24 · CHRISTMASEVE-01 · Hurting on Christmas Eve**

It is Christmas Eve and your neck still hurts from that crash.  
You told yourself you would deal with it after the holidays.  
I get it. Nobody wants to spend the season in a clinic.  
But waiting is exactly what makes a crash injury harder to prove later. Enjoy tonight. Call us this week.  
Get checked here first. nowhiplash.com.

---
**Dec 25 · LIFTINGKIDS-01 · Christmas morning**

Christmas morning. The kids run at you and you want to pick them up the way you always do.  
And your neck says no.  
That moment is information. It tells you the injury is affecting the things that matter most.  
Do not let it become normal. Merry Christmas from all of us. We are here when you are ready.  
nowhiplash.com.

---
**Dec 26 · PASSIVE-01 · Heat pack, ten minutes, see you Thursday (bold)**

Heat pack. Ten minutes on a machine. A quick adjustment. See you Thursday.  
If that is every appointment, week after week, ask what is actually changing.  
Passive care can calm things down early. A real plan moves you toward active work as you improve.  
If the routine never changes, your care is not progressing. It is repeating.  
nowhiplash.com.

---
**Dec 27 · NEWYEARGYM-01 · New year, new gym, old crash**

New year, and you are ready to get back in the gym. But you got rear ended a few weeks ago.  
Loading an injured neck before anybody has examined it is a gamble.  
Get examined first. Find out what that joint can actually handle right now.  
Then train smart and build from there, instead of starting the year with a setback.  
nowhiplash.com.

---
**Dec 28 · SECONDCRASH-01 · Your second crash**

This is your second crash, and you are worried they will blame the first one for everything.  
That is exactly why this one needs a clean examination now.  
A good record shows what was there before, what changed, and when.  
Without it, everything gets called old. With it, the new injury has a date.  
Get checked here first. nowhiplash.com.

---
**Dec 29 · BETTER-01 · "Better" is not a measurement (bold)**

You told them you were feeling better, and that was the end of your care.  
"Better" is a feeling. It is not a measurement.  
Before anyone releases you, somebody should measure your range of motion, your strength, and your symptoms, and write down how they compare to day one.  
If nobody did, you were not released. You were just let go.  
nowhiplash.com.

---
**Dec 30 · YEAREND-01 · Do not carry it into next year**

Crashed in December? The new year is coming fast, and so is the urge to deal with it later.  
Later is how a two week injury turns into a two year problem.  
You do not need a resolution. You need an examination.  
Do it this week, and walk into the new year knowing what you are working with.  
Get checked here first. nowhiplash.com.
